cover:
Use case: product-mockup. Create a high resolution portrait 4:5 editorial product photograph for the standalone companion "Charim — A Tea Diary" by millionroutines. This is a small A6 sewn-bound diary (105 x 148 mm, about 80 pages) with a muted celadon tea-green cloth-textured cover (#90afa0), fine warm-ivory lettering and one very small debossed cup-shaped circle near the lower cover. Input image is the exact minimal five-petal flower brand emblem; use it discreetly as a tiny ivory mark near the brand signature, without replacing the cup-shaped emboss detail. Show one CLOSED diary in three-quarter view with its removable warm-white paper band slipped halfway off and resting beside it, on a clean porcelain-white surface with subtle natural shadows. Cover typography precisely reads, in restrained centered Korean serif and small modern sans:
"차림"
"CHARIM"
"A Tea Diary"
"Keep a little of each cup."
"by millionroutines"
Paper band visible text exactly "Your tea time, in your own words."
Use substantial breathing room, quiet Korean modern heritage luxury, near-black, porcelain white and celadon palette, light nacre-inspired line only on band edge, no ornate shell patterns on cover, no gold, no purple, no extra notebook, no pen, no flowers, no ceramics, no other props, no human, no watermark. Clear book proportions and realistic fine cloth, uncoated paper edge and sewn spine. An original prospective physical product design concept, not a production photograph.
open: Use case: product-mockup. Landscape 3:2 high resolution editorial photo of an OPEN A6 sewn-bound tea diary lying comfortably almost flat on a clean porcelain-white table. Use the supplied image as the exact interior layout reference: the left page is headed "The Cup" and the right page "The Moment", with restrained muted green small prompts, warm-white uncoated paper and very fine writing lines. Preserve the section names FRAGRANCE, COLOR, TASTE, NEXT TIME on the left and the reflective prompts on the right as closely as possible. An 80-page book with realistic thin paper stack, delicate visible center gutter and muted celadon tea-green cloth cover edges. Quiet modern Korean editorial design with ivory paper and near-black serif headings. Camera overhead at a subtle three-quarter angle so the full spread is readable, generous space around the book. No handwriting, no extra entries, no pen, no cup, no flowers, no extra notebook, no ornament, no gold, no purple. Realistic cloth and paper texture, clear fine typography and extremely crisp detail. This is a physical product concept mockup; do not add explanatory text outside the book.
note: Actual 80-page PDF and rendered previews provide authoritative text; mockups illustrate physical materials and binding.
